attackers_goals: An attacker may attempt to exploit the Active Directory Certificate Services to escalate privileges to a domain controller or privileged account.
description: A privileged certificate was requested via certificate template.
investigative_actions: Check if this is a legitimate certificate request. Check if the certificate issued was used to request a Kerberos ticket. Investigate actions done with the issued certificate and its owner. Check for possible NTLM relay alerts.
name: Privileged certificate request via certificate template
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
